verified_facts: In commit c6e4f9e, benchmarks/baseline_f_major.json was overwritten by re-running scripts/evaluate_transcription.py against the post-fix codebase using assets/test_audio/soft-easy-piano-calming-melody_75bpm_F_major.wav and --expected-key 'F major'.

Both benchmarks/baseline_f_major.json and benchmarks/after_fixes_f_major.json in c6e4f9e have refiner_stats.enabled=true, tempo=73.8 BPM, raw_count=109, refined_count=63, reattack_merges=46, and identical artifact sizes (raw_notes.json=17771B, score.mid=445B, score.musicxml=42357B, score.pdf=6905B).

The earlier reported baseline (143.6 BPM, 111 raw notes, refiner_stats.enabled=false, 8 measures, 16 overflow measures) originated from commit d9afd2a before processor.py, note_refiner.py, analyzer.py, and generator.py were modified in c6e4f9e.

divergences: scripts/evaluate_transcription.py calls estimate_tempo(wav_path, ...) without passing notes=refined_notes, whereas worker_agent.py and pipeline.py pass notes=refined_notes.
RealTranscriptionHandler does not render PDF during worker execution (PDF is rendered on-demand via API).
ScoreData persists raw_onset_sec/raw_offset_sec on surviving refined notes, not dropped/merged raw note events.

confirmed_defects.summary: reattack_debounce merges pedaled/sustained repeated notes because gap <= 0.035s is never treated as a genuine re-articulation (39 of 46 merges had onset_diff > 250ms, up to 2.416s).
MusicXML drops 1 note (MIDI 69 / A4) relative to MIDI (62 vs 63 notes) when two same-pitch notes quantize to identical (start_ql, end_ql).
Baseline benchmark JSON was overwritten by a post-fix run in commit c6e4f9e; benchmarks_artifacts/ was also committed outside benchmarks/.
PDF engraving uses proportional-time notehead placement with solid circles only (no rhythmic noteheads/beams/rests/accidentals/key signatures) and renders footer bullet as \177 in WinAnsi.
Evaluator omits notes=refined_notes in estimate_tempo() and lacks WAV SHA-256 + git commit SHA recording.

unverified_without_ground_truth: True note-level onset/pitch precision, recall, and F1 against ground-truth MIDI.
Whether any of the 46 merged reattacks are true repeated notes vs sustain-tail re-triggers.
Whether the 4 remaining octave pairs in refined_notes are intentional piano octaves or harmonic ghosts.
